svg.aria-label: VCU wiring schematic: ESP32, CAN controller, microSD, wheel Hall, throttle, two brake switches and IMU, with every pull-up, divider and decoupling part
svg.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: pins drawn by function, not by header position
skip R8/R9 if the module has them
1 Dashed = planned, not wired yet. Solid = on the bench today (2026-11-01).
2 Every pull-up goes to +3V3, never +5V: ESP32 inputs are not 5 V tolerant.
3 GND is one net. It meets the vehicle only at J5 pin − (CAN ground), DEC-004.
4 To confirm: throttle full-scale, brake NO/NC and dry contact, DC-DC rating.
